title: Ethical and Social Issues Around Data Collection

content.value: Data reflects choices about who is measured, what is recorded, and who is excluded. Check representativeness, consent, provenance, privacy, licensing, and security. Removing a name does not guarantee anonymity. Report limitations and avoid treating correlation as proof of causation.
The rate is 0.8, but it describes these participants only. It does not automatically represent every student. No names are necessary for this aggregate statistic.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
